title: Convolutional Neural Networks
description: Learn convolution mathematics, receptive fields, classic architectures (LeNet to Vision Transformers), and transfer learning.
objectives: Understand convolution operations and receptive fields
Implement CNNs from scratch and with Keras
Master architecture evolution: LeNet to ResNet to ViT
Apply feature visualization and transfer learning
Build image classifiers on real datasets
keyTakeaways: Convolutions = shared-weight filters that detect spatial patterns; kernel size and stride control receptive field growth
Pooling (max/avg) downsamples feature maps and provides translation invariance at the cost of spatial resolution
ResNet skip connections let gradients flow directly through identity paths — solves vanishing gradients in very deep nets
Transfer learning: freeze early layers (generic features), fine-tune later layers on your task-specific data
Vision Transformers (ViT) replace convolutions with patch-level self-attention — competitive with CNNs at large scale
